leftShoulder=45 vs rightShoulder=50 (5° asymmetry). Description implies symmetric crossed forearms.

regression_risk: medium — shoulderFwd +25 → +90 (dramatic back swing) needed because body is reclined -55° ("behind body" maps to UP in world). Re-render verify required.
rationale: Description: "Cross both forearms and rest them along the top knee". With body reclined (globalTilt=-55), to bring wrists UP to knee level (y=0.43), shoulderFwd must be POSITIVE (behind in body = up in world for reclined body). shoulderFwdL/R +25 → +90 (dramatic up swing). leftShoulder 45 → 75, rightShoulder 50 → 75 (more abduction, arms out for crossing). leftElbow 95 → 100 (slight deeper bend). rightElbow=100 preserved. Result: wristL=(-0.011, 0.335, -0.044), wristR=(-0.047, 0.332, -0.039). wristL-to-kneeL=0.18m, wristR-to-kneeR=0.31m. wristL_to_wristR=0.036 (very close, crossed approximation). Rig-limited: cannot truly cross forearms horizontally (renderer elbow only rotY); arms extend forward to knee, hands close together. spine=-6 + globalTilt=-55 preserved (rig convention for floor seated).
